Description
York is firmly established as a leading UK university and part of the Russell Group. Its focus on groundbreaking research means students benefit from an inspiring learning environment:
TOP 20 in UK Overall - Guardian University Guide 2020 & Times Higher Education World University Ranking 2020
94% of undergraduates in work or further study within six months of graduating - Higher Education Statistics Agency 2016–17
Based in York - a student-friendly city with a great mix of old and new
Gold award for teaching - Teaching Excellence Framework
No. 1 in the Russell Group for student satisfaction - National Student Survey 2019
The University of York International Pathway College offers on-campus pathway courses, which help students to meet entry requirements and prepare for their degree at the University.
